INSERT INTO "conversation_tool_call_execution" ( "creator_id", "modifier_id", "turn_id", "response_tool_call_id", "execution_order", "tool_key", "status", "result_content", "result_content_parts", "raw_result", "error_message", "start_time", "end_time" ) VALUES
( #{item.creatorId}, #{item.modifierId}, #{item.turnId}, #{item.responseToolCallId}, #{item.executionOrder}, #{item.toolKey}, #{item.status}, #{item.resultContent}, CAST(#{item.resultContentParts} AS JSONB), #{item.rawResult}, #{item.errorMessage}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT round."round_number" AS "roundNumber", turn."turn_number" AS "turnNumber", execution."execution_order" AS "executionOrder", response_call."tool_call_id" AS "toolCallId", response_call."function_name" AS "toolName", execution."tool_key" AS "toolKey", response_call."arguments" AS "arguments", execution."status" AS "status", execution."result_content" AS "resultContent", execution."error_message" AS "errorMessage" FROM "conversation_tool_call_execution" execution INNER JOIN "conversation_llm_response_tool_call" response_call ON response_call."id" = execution."response_tool_call_id" AND response_call."turn_id" = execution."turn_id" INNER JOIN "conversation_turn" turn ON turn."id" = execution."turn_id" INNER JOIN "conversation_round" round ON round."id" = turn."round_id" WHERE round."conversation_id" = #{conversationId} AND round."deleted" = FALSE ORDER BY round."round_number", turn."turn_number", execution."execution_order"
